_note: 英語島文法分區 sidecar：一檔一單元一 KP。unit_id＝KP id＝eng.t_adv.pattern.run-on-comma-splice（連寫句／逗號接合的辨識與修正，t_adv 學測級）。連寫句（run-on/fused）＝兩個獨立子句之間完全沒有標點或連接詞；逗號接合（comma splice）＝兩個獨立子句只用一個逗號相連、無對等連接詞。四種修法：(1) 句號分成兩句；(2) 分號；(3) 逗號＋對等連接詞 FANBOYS；(4) 用從屬連接詞讓其中一句變從屬子句。核心示例：I was tired, I went home.（逗號接合）→ I was tired. I went home. ／ I was tired; I went home. ／ I was tired, so I went home. ／ Because I was tired, I went home.。每題只有一個真正的修正選項（避免多解）。MCQ 每題唯一可辯護正解＋distractor_rationales＋answer_evidence。R14：teach body 全英文、中文放 zh_hint。以 Swan/Cambridge/Oxford 查證、status provisional、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。含純文字 shadowing（無音檔）。

units.title_zh: 連寫句與逗號接合的辨識與修正
units.can_do: 我能認出連寫句（兩獨立子句無標點無連接詞）和逗號接合（兩獨立子句只用逗號），並用句號、分號、逗號＋對等連接詞或從屬連接詞把它修正。
units.situation_group: 句型：連寫句與逗號接合 Run-ons & comma splices
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A run-on (fused) sentence wrongly joins two independent clauses with no punctuation and no connecting word: 'She loves music she plays the piano' is a run-on.
claims.verification_ref: 連寫句＝兩個獨立子句之間無標點也無連接詞（She loves music she plays the piano）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A comma splice wrongly joins two independent clauses with only a comma and no coordinating conjunction: 'She loves music, she plays the piano' is a comma splice.
claims.verification_ref: 逗號接合＝兩個獨立子句只用一個逗號相連、無對等連接詞（She loves music, she plays the piano）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A run-on or comma splice can be fixed in several ways: (1) use a period to make two sentences; (2) use a semicolon; (3) add a comma plus a coordinating conjunction (for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so); or (4) make one clause dependent with a subordinating conjunction: 'I was tired. I went home.' / 'I was tired; I went home.' / 'I was tired, so I went home.' / 'Because I was tired, I went home.'
claims.verification_ref: 修法四選一：句號分兩句／分號／逗號＋對等連接詞／從屬連接詞（I was tired → I was tired. I went home. / I was tired; I went home. / I was tired, so I went home. / Because I was tired, I went home.）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Two independent clauses cannot simply be pushed together. A run-on (fused) sentence joins two independent clauses with no punctuation and no connecting word. This is an error.
teach.zh_hint: 兩個獨立子句不能硬擠在一起。連寫句（run-on）＝兩個獨立子句之間完全沒有標點、也沒有連接詞。這是錯誤。

teach.body: Run-on (wrong): My phone is old it still works well.
teach.zh_hint: 連寫句（錯）：My phone is old it still works well.（old 和 it 之間什麼都沒有）

teach.body: A comma splice is also an error: it joins two independent clauses with only a comma and no coordinating conjunction. A comma alone is not strong enough to hold two complete sentences together.
teach.zh_hint: 逗號接合（comma splice）也是錯的：它用『一個逗號』連接兩個獨立子句，卻沒有對等連接詞。單一個逗號不夠力撐住兩個完整的句子。

teach.body: Comma splice (wrong): I was tired, I went home.
teach.zh_hint: 逗號接合（錯）：I was tired, I went home.（只用逗號連兩個獨立子句）

teach.body: You can fix a run-on or comma splice in four ways: (1) use a period to make two separate sentences; (2) use a semicolon; (3) add a comma plus a coordinating conjunction (FANBOYS: for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so); or (4) make one clause dependent with a subordinating conjunction such as 'because' or 'when'.
teach.zh_hint: 連寫句／逗號接合有四種修法：(1) 用句號分成兩句；(2) 用分號（;）；(3) 加『逗號＋對等連接詞』（FANBOYS：for/and/nor/but/or/yet/so）；(4) 用從屬連接詞（如 because、when）讓其中一句變成從屬子句。

teach.body: Fixes for 'I was tired, I went home.': I was tired. I went home. / I was tired; I went home. / I was tired, so I went home. / Because I was tired, I went home.
teach.zh_hint: 修正『I was tired, I went home.』：I was tired. I went home.（句號）／ I was tired; I went home.（分號）／ I was tired, so I went home.（逗號＋so）／ Because I was tired, I went home.（從屬連接詞）

practice.stem: 下列哪一句是『逗號接合（comma splice）』的錯誤句？
practice.answer: It was raining, we stayed inside.
options: It was raining, we stayed inside.
It was raining, so we stayed inside.
It was raining. We stayed inside.
Because it was raining, we stayed inside.

逗號後加了對等連接詞 so，正確連接兩個獨立子句，不是錯誤。
distractor_rationales.Because it was raining, we stayed inside: 用從屬連接詞 Because 讓前句變成從屬子句，正確。

practice.feedback: It was raining, we stayed inside：兩個獨立子句只用一個逗號相連、無連接詞，是逗號接合。

practice.stem: 下列哪一句是『連寫句（run-on）』——兩個獨立子句之間沒有任何標點或連接詞？
practice.answer: The movie ended we left the theater.
options: The movie ended we left the theater.
The movie ended, so we left the theater.
The movie ended; we left the theater.
After the movie ended, we left the theater.

用逗號＋對等連接詞 so 連接，正確，不是連寫句。
用分號連接兩個獨立子句，正確。
distractor_rationales.After the movie ended, we left the theat: 用從屬連接詞 After 讓前句變從屬子句，正確。

practice.feedback: The movie ended we left the theater：ended 和 we 之間無標點無連接詞，是連寫句。

practice.stem: 下面是逗號接合的錯誤句，選出正確的修正：『She was hungry, she made a sandwich.』
practice.answer: She was hungry, so she made a sandwich.
options: She was hungry, so she made a sandwich.
She was hungry, she made a sandwich.
She was hungry she made a sandwich.
She was, hungry so she made a sandwich.

這還是原本的逗號接合錯誤，沒有修正。
兩個獨立子句之間完全沒有標點或連接詞，反而變成連寫句，錯更多。
逗號放在 was 和 hungry 之間位置錯誤，句子不通。

practice.feedback: She was hungry, so she made a sandwich：逗號＋對等連接詞 so，正確修正逗號接合。

practice.stem: 選出用分號（;）正確修正的句子：
practice.answer: The sky turned dark; the wind grew stronger.
options: The sky turned dark; the wind grew stronger.
The sky turned dark, the wind grew stronger.
The sky turned dark the wind grew stronger.
The sky turned dark; and the wind grew stronger.

distractor_rationales.The sky turned dark, the wind grew stron: 只用一個逗號連接兩個獨立子句，是逗號接合錯誤。
distractor_rationales.The sky turned dark the wind grew strong: 兩子句間無標點無連接詞，是連寫句。
distractor_rationales.The sky turned dark; and the wind grew s: 分號本身已能連接兩個獨立子句，不需再加 and；分號又加對等連接詞是多餘的。

practice.feedback: The sky turned dark; the wind grew stronger：用分號連接兩個獨立子句，正確。

practice.stem: 選出用從屬連接詞正確修正連寫句『He missed the bus he was late for school.』的句子：
practice.answer: Because he missed the bus, he was late for school.
options: Because he missed the bus, he was late for school.
He missed the bus, he was late for school.
He missed the bus he was late for school.
He missed the bus so he was late for school.

distractor_rationales.He missed the bus, he was late for schoo: 只用一個逗號連接兩個獨立子句，是逗號接合，沒有修正。
distractor_rationales.He missed the bus he was late for school: 兩子句間無標點無連接詞，仍是連寫句。
distractor_rationales.He missed the bus so he was late for sch: so 是對等連接詞、不是題目要求的從屬連接詞；而且用 so 連接兩個獨立子句時，前面應加逗號。

practice.feedback: Because he missed the bus, he was late for school：用從屬連接詞 Because 讓前句變從屬子句，正確。

practice.stem: 下列哪一句標點完全正確（沒有連寫句或逗號接合的錯誤）？
practice.answer: The test was hard, but everyone passed.
options: The test was hard, but everyone passed.
The test was hard, everyone passed.
The test was hard everyone passed.
The test was hard, everyone, passed.

兩個獨立子句只用一個逗號連接，是逗號接合。
兩子句間無標點無連接詞，是連寫句。
逗號位置錯誤，把 everyone 用逗號前後隔開，句子不通。

practice.feedback: The test was hard, but everyone passed：逗號＋對等連接詞 but，正確連接兩個獨立子句。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀練習（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：出聲讀出修正後的正確句子，在句號、分號、連接詞處自然停頓，感受兩個獨立子句之間需要『夠力的連接』。

lines.text: I was tired, so I went home.
lines.intonation: tired 後逗號稍停、so 帶出結果、句尾下收

lines.text: Because he missed the bus, he was late for school.
lines.intonation: 從屬子句讀完在逗號處停頓，再讀主句、句尾下收
